question.zh-TW: 收集端每個服務都跑 compose.yml 以 digest 釘住的映像嗎？
question.en: Does every collector service run the image digest compose.yml pins?

question.zh-TW: 安裝在收集端的設定檔，與 site.yaml 現在 render 出來的相同嗎？
question.en: Are the files installed on the collector the ones site.yaml renders now?

question.zh-TW: 安裝的版本來自 Release，下載後驗過 SHA256SUMS 與 attestation 嗎？
question.en: Did the installed version come from a Release, with SHA256SUMS and the attestation verified?

check.hint: docs/install.md, download and verify; give the version and the date verified

question.zh-TW: 升級失敗時退得回上一版嗎（上一版 tarball 留著、volume 有備份）？
question.en: Can a failed upgrade go back to the previous version (its tarball kept, the volumes backed up)?

check.hint: where the previous tarball and the volume backup are, and when the rollback was last tried

question.zh-TW: 每個抓取目標都抓得到嗎？
question.en: Is every scrape target up?

question.zh-TW: 收集端 cron 寫的每個 textfile 都在期限內更新嗎？
question.en: Is every textfile the collector's cron writes younger than its stale alert allows?

question.zh-TW: Prometheus 找得到 Alertmanager，而且每個接收者都有送達的地方嗎？
question.en: Does Prometheus reach Alertmanager, and does every receiver send somewhere?

question.zh-TW: 收集端整台停掉時，有收集端以外的東西會發告警嗎（deadman）？
question.en: When the whole collector stops, does something outside it raise the alarm (deadman)?

question.zh-TW: 每台 Linux 與 PVE 主機的 journal 都送到收集端嗎？
question.en: Does every Linux and PVE host ship its journal to the collector?

question.zh-TW: 交換器與無線基地台在監控裡，而且抓得到嗎？
question.en: Are the switches and access points monitored, and answering?

question.zh-TW: PVE 叢集有法定票數嗎？
question.en: Is the PVE cluster quorate?

question.zh-TW: QDevice 有在投票嗎（兩節點叢集少一台還能活）？
question.en: Does the QDevice vote (so a two-node cluster survives one node)?

question.zh-TW: PVE 還原演練在期限內通過過嗎？
question.en: Has a PVE restore drill passed within the drill age limit?

question.zh-TW: NAS 還原演練在期限內通過過嗎？
question.en: Has a NAS restore drill passed within the drill age limit?

question.zh-TW: 異地（雲端）副本的還原演練在期限內通過過嗎？
question.en: Has a restore from the offsite (cloud) copy passed within its age limit?

question.zh-TW: 每個有快照的資料集，最新快照都在期限內嗎？
question.en: Does every dataset with snapshots have a recent one?

question.zh-TW: 每台 NAS 都接了 UPS 嗎？
question.en: Does every NAS have a UPS?

question.zh-TW: 備份目標本身也有備份嗎（第二台 NAS、HBS 3 或異地）？
question.en: Is the backup target itself backed up (a second NAS, HBS 3 or offsite)?

check.hint: which job copies the backup NAS where, and when it last succeeded

question.zh-TW: 日誌每天封存到 WORM，並且驗證通過嗎？
question.en: Are the logs archived to WORM every day, and verified?

question.zh-TW: 防火牆的阻擋紀錄有在彙整與告警嗎？
question.en: Are the firewall drops collected and alerted on?

question.zh-TW: 封包擷取有進 WORM，而且驗證通過嗎？
question.en: Do the packet captures reach WORM, and verify?

question.zh-TW: 可接受使用（網頁過濾）的報表有在產生嗎？
question.en: Is the acceptable-use (web filter) report being written?

question.zh-TW: 資產都有生命週期日期，而且沒有已過期還在用的？
question.en: Does every asset have an end-of-life date, and is none past it?

question.zh-TW: 變更以 Markdown 變更單記錄，而且收集端讀得到嗎？
question.en: Are changes recorded as Markdown change records the collector reads?

question.zh-TW: 設備上的管理動作都對得到變更單嗎？
question.en: Does every management action on the devices match a change record?

question.zh-TW: 高風險變更的回退都演練過，而且不過期嗎？
question.en: Has the rollback of every high-risk change been drilled, recently?

question.zh-TW: 代理人閘道在跑，稽核鏈完整嗎？
question.en: Is the agent gate running, with its audit chain intact?

question.zh-TW: 每張核准過的變更單，核准者都不是執行者本人嗎？
question.en: Is every approved change approved by someone other than its implementer?

question.zh-TW: 近 90 天完成的變更單都記了人力時間（effort_min）嗎？
question.en: Does every change done in the last 90 days record its staff time (effort_min)?

question.zh-TW: 每台 GB10 的 gb10-textfile 都在兩分鐘內更新嗎？
question.en: Has gb10-textfile run within two minutes on every GB10 node?

question.zh-TW: 每台 GB10 都跑著 gb10-host-guard（記憶體耗盡前終止程序）嗎？
question.en: Does gb10-host-guard (which ends a process before memory runs out) run on every GB10 node?

check.hint: systemctl is-active gb10-host-guard on each node, and the date checked
